WITH
    order_gross AS (
        SELECT
            o.merchant_id,
            SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales
        FROM orders o
        GROUP BY o.merchant_id
    ),
    order_discounts_agg AS (
        SELECT
            o.merchant_id,
            SUM(d.amount) AS total_discount_amount
        FROM orders o
        LEFT JOIN order_discounts d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
        GROUP BY o.merchant_id
    ),
    order_shipments_agg AS (
        SELECT
            o.merchant_id,
            SUM(s.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
        FROM orders o
        LEFT JOIN order_shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
        GROUP BY o.merchant_id
    )
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    COALESCE(g.total_gross_sales, 0)      AS total_gross_sales,
    COALESCE(d.total_discount_amount, 0)  AS total_discount_amount,
    COALESCE(s.total_shipping_fees, 0)    AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
LEFT JOIN order_gross g          ON m.merchant_id = g.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN order_discounts_agg d ON m.merchant_id = d.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN order_shipments_agg s ON m.merchant_id = s.merchant_id;

WITH agg_discounts AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_discount
    FROM order_discounts
    GROUP BY order_id
),
agg_shipments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
    FROM order_shipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.total_discount), 0.00) AS total_discount_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.total_shipping), 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
JOIN orders o ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN agg_discounts d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN agg_shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name;

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH ordered_events AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_ts
    FROM user_events
),
session_markers AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_ts IS NULL 
                 OR event_timestamp - prev_ts > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM ordered_events
),
session_ids AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_id
    FROM session_markers
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_ids
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Stage User Onboarding Conversion Funnel
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH view_events AS (
    SELECT user_id, MIN(event_time) AS view_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    WHERE event_name = 'view_item'
    GROUP BY user_id
),
cart_events AS (
    SELECT ue.user_id, MIN(ue.event_time) AS cart_time
    FROM user_journey_events ue
    JOIN view_events v
        ON ue.user_id = v.user_id
    WHERE ue.event_name = 'add_to_cart'
      AND ue.event_time > v.view_time
    GROUP BY ue.user_id
),
purchase_events AS (
    SELECT ue.user_id, MIN(ue.event_time) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events ue
    JOIN cart_events c
        ON ue.user_id = c.user_id
    WHERE ue.event_name = 'purchase'
      AND ue.event_time > c.cart_time
    GROUP BY ue.user_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM view_events)        AS total_viewers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM cart_events)        AS converted_cart,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM purchase_events)    AS converted_purchase;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH user_stages AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_time END) AS cart_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN event_time END) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time AND purchase_time > cart_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_stages;
